title: Silence and filler cutter (ffmpeg)
what_it_does: Removes dead air from a recording with ffmpeg silencedetect, keeps a margin around words, re-cuts frame-accurately. With a word-level transcript it can also drop filler words and use different pause lengths inside and after sentences. --list shows the cut plan without writing a file.
when_to_use: First pass on a raw talking-head take, before captions and overlays.
why: MIT, stdlib-only Python, dry-run and JSON output, 26k lines with tests and evals; the most complete silence cutter of the eight repos and needs no API.
